description: What a PRG32 Store bundle is, what the Cartridge Store accepts, and what its refusals mean. One file for the kit and the Store (docs/store_contract.md).

rules: manifest.json is a UTF-8 JSON object at the top of the zip
every file the manifest names (assets.icon, assets.splash, architectures[].file) is in the zip, by a relative name without '..'
the icon (and splash, if any) is PNG or JPEG
each architectures[].file ends in .prg32 and is a PRG32 cartridge (magic PRG2)

versioning.kit_rule: The kit's manifest version is 0.1.<project version>: every saved change gives a new version, and an unchanged project republishes the same one.
versioning.known_store_gap: The Cartridge Store (820f74b) accepts a second pending submission with the same id and version; approving it replaces that version's published files. The kit never sends the same id/version twice from one review (publish attempts are idempotent by digest) and asks the Store to refuse duplicates (proposal in docs/store_contract.md).
versioning.kit_duplicate_rule: The kit sends one bundle per cartridge id and version to a Store: the same files again answer with the first result (nothing is uploaded), different files are refused with version_already_published until the project is saved (a new version).
versioning.store_proposal: CartridgeStore refuses an upload whose id/version is already published or pending with a different bundle digest (409, code duplicate_version) and accepts the same digest again idempotently. Until then this section's duplicate_identity_version stays store_accepts_duplicate_pending.

publish.visibility: A submission is not listed in GET /api/games until an editor verifies it (POST /api/submissions/<id>/verify).

tokens.create: POST /auth/tokens (signed in) answers {id, token}; the token is shown once
tokens.revoke: DELETE /auth/tokens/<id>; a revoked token is refused with 401 at once
tokens.known_store_gap: Cartridge Store (820f74b) API tokens never expire; a teacher revokes them by hand. The kit stores the token write-only in the publish profile and never logs it.

kit_rotation.rule: The kit records when a publish profile's token was put in and refuses to use it after this many days (token_too_old); a teacher makes a new token in the Store and revokes the old one.

tokens.store_proposal: POST /auth/tokens accepts expires_in_days (default 180, at most 365); GET /auth/tokens shows expires_at; an expired token is refused with 401 and code token_expired, like a revoked one. Until then expiry stays none.

fields.name: string
fields.store_url: https URL of an approved Store (ADR-0008)
